name: MODLOGO-tag-unread
old:
const tag = guildTagOf(word);
  const byTag = tag ? await db.prepare('SELECT id, name, tag FROM guilds WHERE tag = ?').bind(tag).first() : null;
new:
const tag = null;
  const byTag = tag ? await db.prepare('SELECT id, name, tag FROM guilds WHERE tag = ?').bind(tag).first() : null;
note: A guild named by its tag, the word a moderator reads off a card, would be no guild.

name: MODLOGO-replaced-kept
old: "UPDATE guild_logos SET state = 'withdrawn', decided_at = ?2, decided_by = 'replaced' WHERE guild_id = ?3 AND state = 'approved' AND id <> ?1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guild_logos WHERE id = ?1)",
new: "UPDATE guild_logos SET state = 'withdrawn', decided_at = ?2, decided_by = 'replaced' WHERE guild_id = ?3 AND state = 'pending' AND id <> ?1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guild_logos WHERE id = ?1)",
note: The logo worn before would stay approved beside the new one, its picture kept and served.

name: MODLOGO-fee-charged
old: SELECT ?1, ?2, 'approved', ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, 0, ?8, ?9, ?10, ?11, ?11, ?12, ?13 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guilds WHERE id = ?2)`,
new: SELECT ?1, ?2, 'pending', ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, 0, ?8, ?9, ?10, ?11, ?11, ?12, ?13 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guilds WHERE id = ?2)`,
note: A logo a moderator set would wait on a review nobody asked for, worn by nobody.

name: MODLOGO-proxy-unasked
note: A full-size upload would be read whole off the CDN and refused, where the proxy would have shrunk it.

name: MODLOGO-square-unmeasured
old: if (wide !== tall) return say(`That picture is ${wide} by ${tall} px. A logo is square.`);
new: if (false) return say(`That picture is ${wide} by ${tall} px. A logo is square.`);
note: A picture that is not square would be fetched and refused on its bytes, without saying its measure.
